result.brief: 提出 SufficientPlan 部署框架，通过配对序贯预算认证与静态上下文复用，在不改动预训练世界模型的前提下降低规划搜索预算与延迟。
result.reason: Reduces search/computation in visual world-model planning via budget certification and cached observation/goal representations; contributes to world-model planning efficiency, not a new representation.
